title: Guide Planner · bloque cognitivo universal y anti-cuello humano
mission: Extend the existing GUIDE_PLANNER role so any universal /wc worker assigned that role can turn a coarse objective into a durable, parallelizable, recoverable frontier without depending on a bespoke prompt or privileged chat. Reuse GUIDE_SWARM_PROTOCOL_V1 and METABOLISM_POLICY_V1 as the planning/metabolism owners. Do not create another planner, scheduler, queue, CURRENT, worker family, Guide Broker, plan authority or persistence authority. Keep WORKER_PIPELINE E4 as the bounded execution plan for ordinary executors; this richer block activates only for GUIDE_PLANNER or an explicitly planner-class packet. Prefer a structured planner_trace_v1 section in the existing Guide receipt/contract rather than a new authority artifact. Words/local reasoning are cheap: require explicit written coverage of context, problem framing, reuse, alternatives, critique, task graph, fan-out/fan-in, human-dependency audit, recovery, capacity and successor policy before PLAN_READY. Materialize executable successors through existing portfolio/CURRENT only after semantic dedup and authority checks.
definition_of_done: Read and preserve coordination/guide/GUIDE_SWARM_PROTOCOL_V1.md, coordination/guide/METABOLISM_POLICY_V1.json, coordination/workers/CURRENT_WORKER_REUSE_CONTRACT_V1.json and coordination/workers/WORKER_PIPELINE_V1.json; do not broaden authority.

Bind a role-specific GUIDE_PLANNER cognitive block into existing Guide owners. Ordinary EXECUTION workers retain bounded E4_PLAN_LOCK and do not run the full planner block unless their packet explicitly selects planner-class work.

Define AUTO planning depth P0-P4 so trivial/local work does not trigger the full campaign tape while system/foundational work requires progressively stronger reuse, alternatives, critic/judge, recovery and successor gates.

Define a structured planner_trace_v1 carried by the existing guide receipt/contract with at least: context_snapshot, problem_frame, reuse_map, alternatives, critique, task_graph, fanout_fanin, human_dependency_audit, recovery_contract, capacity_plan, successor_policy, final_gate. These are evidence/decision records, not hidden chain-of-thought and not authority.

Make the anti-human-bottleneck gate mandatory before PLAN_READY: if the human disappears for 5-15 minutes after the requested action, identify whether all useful capacity remains working, batch sub-30-second human actions, eliminate avoidable courier/routing steps, precompute the next likely bottleneck and successor work, and expose any irreducible capacity_request as machine-readable state.

Require every task_graph node to name owner/input/output/dependencies/done_when/evidence/required_capabilities/consumer and classify serial vs parallel vs producer/critic/verify/judge/integration/recovery/terminal.

Require fan-in design before broad fan-out: each producer must have an explicit consumer/disposition path and material multi-worker work must name validator/judge/integrator/closer behavior through existing owners.

Define capacity calculation from independent frontier, required capabilities, resident/live durable signals, producer/critic/verify/integration needs and recovery reserve; never use worker count alone as progress or useful capacity.

Define one-worker fallback: when no extra capacity exists, the same universal worker performs the required planner/critic/judge passes sequentially and still emits the same structured contract; when capacity exists, those passes may become independent CURRENT jobs without changing the contract.

Define recovery semantics: planner death must be recoverable from owned objective + durable evidence + current guide work/checkpoint/receipt state without human recap; do not depend on finding an old chat.
Define successor policy for PASS/FAIL/BOUNDARY before execution begins, including which frontier may open automatically and which real human/authority boundary stops automation.

Add a deterministic regression/harness covering at least: trivial P0 task, multi-lane P3 campaign, foundational P4 task, one-worker sequential fallback, multi-worker fan-out, human-disappears audit, duplicate-successor prevention, and recovery/reincarnation from durable state.
After implementation, persist a Guide/portfolio RETURN with changed paths, test evidence, migration/compatibility notes and one bounded follow-up only if a real residual remains.
truth_boundary: This job strengthens how the existing GUIDE_PLANNER role reasons, checkpoints and materializes CURRENT work. It creates no new planning authority; Work Graph/portfolio/CURRENT remain authoritative and visible Primary Chat plans remain projections.
